steps: A. Prepare (resolve repository, branch, target path, base commit SHA, current file SHA)
B. Validate (reject empty/no-op patch, check stale base SHA conflict, run syntax check)
C. Apply (generate unified diff and compute expected Git blob SHA1)
D. Commit (commit via GitHub Contents API or divert to ryn/ai-run-<id> branch + Draft PR if branch is protected)
E. Read-Back Verification (re-fetch file from GitHub with cache-busting and compare SHA256 + Git blob SHA)
F. Verify Commit (confirm commit SHA exists on target branch)
G. Report (return SAVED_AND_VERIFIED, NEEDS_ATTENTION, NO_OP, CONFLICT, or FAILED)
non_negotiable_rule: Never report saved/edited/committed unless read-back content and blob SHA match expected bytes.
